Ten Hivra things, in the order you said them. Tally doesn’t own Hivra, and I’m not building any of this in the Tally repo.
Onboarding copy is too long, cut it in half

Add a FAQ bit about refunds

Signup button colour clashes with the logo
Mobile nav overlaps the logo on small phones
Need a privacy page before launch
Stripe test mode is still on in staging, check
Dashboard takes 6 seconds to load
No on the red ones, until Chief of Staff says otherwise. Waitlist email and DKIM, the refunds FAQ, a privacy page before launch, and Stripe in staging. Taking “beta” off the public price page sits with those: it changes what the live page claims.

Done: the kids-mode note, the hub-launch thread, the Android reply, and one pin idea. The pin: one post that says what the hub is in a single line, "one project, one Today, you talk to the lead." The clear hub fixes are in a preview now: inbox row height, settings scroll, rail badge, overnight on Today, send button, model picker, undo after archive, dark code blocks, search in a chat, Being built by project, archive away from delete, dock badge.

Parked: waitlist DKIM, refunds FAQ, privacy page before launch, Stripe test mode, and taking "beta" off the price page. I said no and asked Chief of Staff, with what yes and no each mean. Also parked, no Hivra project: onboarding copy, the hero gif, the signup colour, the mobile nav, the 6-second dashboard. No Nibbii project: recent colours, PNG edges, share link, iPad step 3, undo after rotate, brushes by most used, App Store screenshots. The store reply stays unsent. Who asked about Hivra last week, and what people are saying about MonoCode this week, are parked because the lookup failed and I have no X access.
